candidates.statement: Order service postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool reports size=5 and idle=0 across all sampled traces, so checkout requests time out and the gateway returns 502. Order metrics show 13.7/min of /v1/orders 503s and postgres save_order failures, with p95 latency ~3.3s.
candidates.uncertainty: Pool size/idle come from trace attributes only; no postgres server-side metrics or pool wait-time histograms were admitted to confirm saturation versus postgres unavailability.

report.explanation: Traces show checkout 502s caused by order ReadTimeout, with postgres save_order returning DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5. Order metrics corroborate 503s on /v1/orders and postgres save_order failures. Deployment record only establishes order v1.0.0 and does not establish deployment-caused latency. Redis and payment calls succeed, arguing against redis-timeout and downstream-latency.
